title: JSFL: fl.browseForFileURL and fl.browseForFolderURL stubs missing
description: The fl object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts is missing fl.browseForFileURL(description, fileType?) and fl.browseForFolderURL(description). In Flash 8 JSFL these open native file/folder pickers. Fix: add both methods to JsflFl interface and proxy. In the browser context, use the HTML5 <input type=file> element via a programmatic click to get a File object, then return a fake file:// URL from the file.name (or return null if user cancels). browseForFolderURL can always return null with a console.warn. Priority: low.
